notes.drag: carriage drag index (10^4 x the drag coefficient on the F-16's 300 sq ft wing, flight-model.md §9.18): 0.25 x its 0.458 m across (inferred: its bomb body's) frontal area, 0.25 the drag of a body with a guidance kit (strakes, folded wings) on its pylon on that area (inferred); the F-16 manual's published indices were not at hand
notes.kg: the 2,000 lb class (907 kg); its own weight is not published
notes.power: the MK-84's (its body; our damage scale)
notes.sim: the sim flies modern_weapons.gd's record 1011, built on the MK-84, in its place (loadout::sim_load): the SPICE 1000's GPS / INS guidance, no wings
notes.generation: ours: the weapons.ibx section key (generation · 1000 + type) is one per weapon of a kind
notes.range_km: 60 km as Wikipedia gives it, from 40,000 ft at Mach 0.9 (the release inferred, as the SPICE 1000's): glide ratio 4.1 (modern_weapons.gd SPICE2)
